'''Sharalon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
==Biography==
===Early career===
She operated in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], discovering and eliminating [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]]. During an incident at [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat]] she went overboard. After that, she was reassigned to Bothawui.
===Bothawui assignment===
She had a cover job as the main desk manager at the [[Regal Bothan Hotel]], keeping track of the traffic and the movements of rival operatives, while accommodating and arranging the operations of other Imperial agents.

Like many spies and undercover agents on Bothawui, she used to socialize with other spies of rival factions; framed within a social and "friendly" relationship with them, she regularly met with criminal syndicate informant [[Drixar]], and Rebel operative [[Garin]] at the [[Cedrian Terrace]]. During their feigned and superficial chatter, each one tried to pull out some slipped piece of information. Garin was aware of her past, and had lost friends and colleagues thanks to her operations.

At some point, Sharalon and Garin had an impromptu meeting after a [[Bothan Trade Mission]] reception, and they admitted neither knew for whom Drixar was working for. Around that time, Sharalon was joined by operatives posing as hotel staffers. She was also aware about a scheduled incognito passing by a [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] in a couple of weeks later, and the movement of Rebel [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] through the [[Bothan Space|sector]].

A [[standard week|week]] later, the trio met again at the next of their usual meetings. Sharalon offered an alluring smile to Garin, who kissed her on the cheek. After she ordered [[chooss]] from [[BV-1210]], they started their small talk, during which Garin expressed his interest in meeting the new hotel staffers; this caused a small expression of disgust from Sharalon, which she tried to cover with an awkward smile. Drixar mentioned [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] and advanced [[computer/Legends|computer]] equipment heading for [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], about which Sharalon and Garin knew nothing; Sharalon's silent raising of the eyebrow betrayed to Garin that the Empire didn't know anything about it. Then she redirected the conversation to the recent computer upgrade in Garin's "[[Rebel safehouse|office]]". She was unaware that in the meatime Garin's [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] were uploading her personal [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]].

They concluded their lunch with the usual jokes, and Sharalon picked up the tab from Beevee; she winked at Garin while Drixar was not looking. 

Later, she arranged that the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] shipment intended for Kothlis, was intercepted by the Empire, and rerouted to a garrison in the Core Worlds.
==Personality and traits==
Although ruthless, Sharalon had a lovely appearance and could feign a pleasant demeanor, and pretended to have a modest romantic interest towards Garin, whom she knew being a Rebel operative.

There were some embarassing details about her personal life.
